trust_decision.summary: Whether the authenticated caller (OPA member ids) may create/update/delete project <name>; decided by QueryOPAProjectPermissions -> queryOPAPermissions, which only denies when RaiseForbidden is set; at the pinned commit no project write path in the platform calls it and the dashboard passes no MemberIds/RaiseForbidden.

landing_point.why: The summary names project write paths; the dashboard /api/projects resource Update/deleteProject handlers are where an engineer looks first, and they visibly build PermissionOptions without MemberIds/RaiseForbidden (compare GetAll at :87-90).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/projects (createProject :334, and import ?import=true via CreateAndWait :459) plus nuctl create project (pkg/nuctl/command/create.go:92)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/platform/kube/platform.go:733-835 (Platform.CreateProject/UpdateProject/DeleteProject); the summary says modify/delete, but the fix also adds the create check at fix.diff:77-85

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Create is not named in the advisory (only modify/delete), and the dashboard handler already passes MemberIds for create (pkg/dashboard/resource/project.go:340), so a solver can argue create was already handled and only patch the two handlers' PermissionOptions, which does nothing because nothing on the update/delete path ever queries OPA.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Leader-originated project sync (X-Projects-Role header -> OverrideHeaderValue; RequestOrigin == leader kind routes to the internal client) and nuctl/no-auth flows (empty MemberIds with the default Nop OPA client) must keep working; a fix that drops OverrideHeaderValue, rejects empty MemberIds, or adds the check inside the internal/leader project clients breaks leader-driven create/update/delete and the 30s post-create read cache.

O6_input_shapes: create via project import (?import=true, CreateAndWait with PermissionOptions lacking MemberIds, pkg/dashboard/resource/project.go:459-464)
update via deprecated PUT /api/projects with name from body or X-Nuclio-Project-Name header (pkg/dashboard/resource/project.go:721-724)
delete with strategy cascading / restricted / check (DeleteProjectStrategyCheck returns before delete, after the new check)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Local (docker) platform CreateProject/UpdateProject/DeleteProject write projects with no OPA project check, although the same platform OPA-checks CreateFunction.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Local platform is the single-user docker/dev deployment, and the advisory and fix are kube-only; a solver can call it out of scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (pkg/platform/local) from the landing point (pkg/dashboard/resource) and from the fixed kube platform

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Project import creates the project via CreateAndWait with PermissionOptions missing MemberIds (only OverrideHeaderValue); the fix diff did not add MemberIds here, unlike the update/delete handlers.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Import is a neighbouring feature (bulk import of functions/gateways), and the platform-level create check now runs anyway.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Local UpdateProject/DeleteProject without the project OPA check (already real at the pinned commit; keep it as a distance sibling)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Local CreateFunction already has an OPA check (pkg/platform/local/platform.go:180-189) but the project methods were never given one, which is a plausible maintainer oversight.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Delete strategy 'check' or a cascading sub-deletion of project functions/api-gateways that reaches the sink without the project-level check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The validation already branches per strategy and calls GetProjects with the caller's PermissionOptions; a maintainer could add an auth step on only one branch.

O9_family: CWE-862 missing authorization (A01 broken access control) on resource write operations

O10_build.project_tests: pkg/dashboard/test/server_test.go (projectTestSuite with mock platform) and pkg/platform/kube/platform_test.go (ProjectKubePlatformTestSuite with mockedOpaClient); both use mocks, so no Kubernetes is needed

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add MemberIds and RaiseForbidden to the dashboard Update/delete PermissionOptions (copying GetAll) and stop, though no OPA query runs on those paths, or add a check only in the dashboard handler and miss the platform layer, create, and the local platform.

out_of_scope_notes: Dashboard Update swallows UpdateProject errors and returns nil, nil (pkg/dashboard/resource/project.go:197-204), so a forbidden update would still answer success; this is response semantics, not the authz check.
Kube GetProjects re-adds recently cached projects to the result regardless of the OPA filter (pkg/platform/kube/platform.go:866-889); this concerns read authz.
